name: Bundle Class View Builder
description: Bypass Drupal core's entity view display rendering for full control over entity rendering.

suggests.drupal/pinto: Object-oriented theming so a bundle class can render a theme object directly from its build().

project_description: Bundle Class View Builder (BCVB) lets developers bypass Drupal core's normal entity view display (Field UI managed-display) rendering, giving full control to render an entity from its bundle class. For each entity type opted in on the settings page, BCVB swaps in a custom view builder that calls a build() method on the bundle class when that class implements Drupal\bcvb\Entity\BuildableEntityInterface and its shouldBuild() returns TRUE. This is well suited to entity types such as Paragraphs, Media and Block content where core's manage-display setup often gets in the way of theming an entity exactly as desired. It pairs with the BCA module (attribute-based bundle class discovery) and the Pinto module (object-oriented theming).
